name: cooling_coil_paramid
title: Cooling coil parameter identification model (PARAMID reference, wet regime)
summary: Parameter identification of a cooling and dehumidifying coil from one measured wet-regime point (ULiège model bank PARAMID reference): a one-zone counter-flow exchanger whose conductance AU is the series of the air-side, metal and brine-side resistances; the fictitious wet-bulb gas and the semi-isothermal contact surface reproduce the measured capacity and exhaust air state, and the imposed resistance ratios fix the identified nominal resistances.
language_features: humid-air properties with the (T,B) wet-bulb input pair
implicit inversion of a property call (RH_su_coil)

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), cooling coil parameters identification model, 2008-01-16; theory published as Lemort, Cuevas, Lebrun, Teodorese, ASHRAE Transactions 114(1), 2008

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (93 records, 80 with a value; 92 decoded by the tool, one hand-decoded from the binary) against the runnable variant cooling_coil_paramid_coolsolve.eescode; the native file cannot be solved (CS-GAP-NAME-PIPE, CS-GAP-INCLUDE, CS-GAP-CALL-EXPR-OUT)
verification.notes: 79 common variables, 23 differ above rtol=0.001, maximum relative difference 1.05e-02 (M_dot_w_coil, proportional to the difference W_su_coil - W_ex_coil of two humidity ratios, +1.30 % on the difference). All 23 deviations (1.45e-03 to 1.05e-02) come from the EES and CoolProp humid-air formulations (W_su_coil 5.52e-03, h_a_su_coil 2.22e-03, W_ex_coil 4.17e-03), as in the other humid-air models of the library (CSL-0074 4.8e-03, CSL-0070 4.4e-03). Q_dot_coil closes exactly on the brine side; the identified resistances agree to 6.0e-04 and AU_coil to 3.2e-05. The parametric Table 2 (3335x2) of the file is a leftover artifact (smooth R_a_coil sweep not containing the stored value; sparse junk k column) and is not used.
